info.name: Wikidata Query Service SPARQL Execute a SPARQL Query (GET)

params.name: query
params.value: SELECT ?item ?itemLabel WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q146 . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" } } LIMIT 10

items.docs: Execute a SPARQL 1.1 SELECT/ASK/CONSTRUCT/DESCRIBE query against the Wikidata graph. Pass the query in the 'query' parameter. Use Accept header to control result format (JSON, XML, CSV, TSV, RDF/XML, Turtle).

info.name: Wikidata Query Service SPARQL Execute a SPARQL Query (POST)

items.docs: Submit a SPARQL query in the request body. Useful when the query is too long for a URL.
